name: Kamiki Yuuto
source:
Yuuto is the protagonist of the game. 

He is the childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c2728]Tomone[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2726]Yuzuna[/url] and he is the cousin of [url=https://vndb.org/c2721]Kikyou[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio[/url].

[spoiler]When he was a child, he had once played weddings with [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c2728]Tomone[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2726]Yuzuna[/url] and the girls quarreled over who would marry Yuuto first. It was finally [url=https://vndb.org/c2729]Komachi[/url] who had won the victory by kissing Yuuto first.[/spoiler]
